|translation='''Title:''' Lieutenant Cabbel.

'''Card text:'''
Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If that ship is Tyrant, also add 1 to armor. When in battle with an Imperial leader, subtract 1 from the opponent’s total battle destiny.

'''Lore:'''
A recent graduate of the officers’ school on Carida. First officer of the Tyrant. Ambitious, ruthless, and able.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese face names the ship as Tyrant for the armor bonus.
